core_obligations: Choose resolutions (proof lines 2452-2462): the author resolves the given bounded below complex by injectives on the source topos, so that Rf_* is computed by the direct image of the resolution.

Compute both sides (proof lines 2462-2478): since g and g' are flat, the pullbacks are computed naively, and the two ways around the diagram give the same complex, which produces the canonical base change map.
Conclude (proof lines 2478-2484): the map is canonical and lives in the bounded below derived category, as asserted.
proof_roadmap: Resolve the complex by injectives so that the derived pushforward is explicit.
Use flatness to compute the pullbacks naively on both sides of the diagram.
Compare the two composites to obtain the canonical base change map.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a canonical base change map g^*Rf_*F^bullet -> R(f')_*(g')^*F^bullet for a commutative diagram of ringed topoi in which both g and g' are flat, F^bullet being a bounded below complex of modules (statement lines 2426-2450, with the Xy-pic diagram delivered verbatim). The proof resolves the complex by injectives so that the derived pushforward is computed explicitly (proof lines 2452-2462), uses flatness to compute the two pullbacks naively (proof lines 2462-2478), and compares the two composites to produce the map (proof lines 2478-2484). The non-formal content is the use of flatness to make the comparison naive. The claim is H2: one resolution choice plus one comparison.
